jobs.description:
What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 
 
• You will work in a cold environment. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night). 
 
• You speak and understand English well.

For our client Kuehne + Nagel, a leading international logistics company, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen their team. Are you accurate and interested in working in an international environment? Then this opportunity is for you!
 

What will you do?
 

 
• Carefully pick and prepare customer orders.
 
• Use a hand scanner to process goods.
 
• Check, label, and safely package products.
 
• Correctly register products in the system.
 
• Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the logistics flow. 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as an Order Picker.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. During busier periods, you may also be required to work on Saturdays.
 
• You can work independently but also function well as part of a team.
 
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
 
• You have your own transportation.

ABOUT THE ROLEYou will be a vital member of our day-to-day operations. You will support the assembly and manufacturing of lower limb prosthetics in compliance with our internal ISO 13485 quality system, manage shop floor inventory alerts and stock movements, handle minor hands-on facility maintenance, and manage product packaging, shipping, and logistics.

We are seeking someone with 1 to 3 years of practical experience who enjoys working with their hands, brings natural curiosity and attention to detail, and wants their daily work to make a real difference in people's mobility.

WHAT YOU WILL DOProduction, Assembly & Quality Compliance (40%)Assemble precisely, test, and inspect lower limb prosthetic components following Work instructions & Standard Operating Procedures.Complete and maintain thorough Device History Records (DHR), lot traceability, and production logs according to training on our ISO 13485 quality system.Operate manufacturing, workshop, and finishing equipment safely while adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices.Conduct incoming receiving inspections and finished assembly quality checks, identifying and logging Non-Conforming Material when necessary.Assist in maintaining a clean, compliant production environment according to company quality guidelines.Inventory Management (25%)Oversee stock movements, receiving, storing, and issuing raw materials, hardware, and sub-assemblies in accordance with controlled inventory practices.Conduct regular cycle counts, inventory audits, and reconcile physical inventory with ERP/inventory software systems.Monitor stock thresholds and raise immediate alerts on low-inventory components to prevent production line stoppages.Organize and maintain controlled inventory storage systems (kitting, lot tracking, labeling, bin locations).Operational Logistics & Shipping (20%)Package finished lower limb prosthetics and sub-assemblies securely according to packaging validation standards.Prepare shipping documentation, freight labels, pick lists, and international customs paperwork as required.Receive, inspect, and log incoming shipments for damage or quality discrepancies against purchase orders.Coordinate pick-ups and deliveries with logistics carriers and shipping vendors.Facility & Office Maintenance (15%)Perform day-to-day minor facility repairs and maintenance (e.g., replacing lightbulbs, minor fixture fixes, basic troubleshooting).Handle physical sorting, moving, and proper disposal/recycling of facility materials, boxes, and non-hazardous scrap components.Maintain shop floor, lab, and office spaces in a clean, calibrated, and organized condition compliant with safety and quality standards.
 
WHAT YOU BRINGSecondary technical diploma (CESS / A2) or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanics, Fine Mechanics, Production Technology, or equivalent practical hands-on experience.1-3 years of hands-on experience in electro-mechanical assembly, technical manufacturing, or inventory-linked production.Ability to read and follow mechanical assembly drawings, schematics, and written step-by-step instructions.A detail-oriented approach with respect for written protocols and patient safety.Working proficiency in French with professional English, OR fluent English with practical French communication skills.Comfortable standing during assembly and lifting items up to 20 kg.
 
WHAT WE OFFER  Competitive base salary and benefits package.Full training on medical device quality systems (ISO 13485), assembly procedures, and inventory practices.Direct impact on products that meaningfully improve human mobility.Dynamic, collaborative startup culture.OUR CULTUREJoin a mission-driven, innovative, and collaborative team at Axiles Bionics. We are shaping the future of bionic technology and human mobility guided by our values of innovation, excellence, and benevolence. PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
 

About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
 

Your Mission: as a 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
 

 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

Compliance & Conformity Management
 
 

• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation. 

• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects. 

• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables. 

• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities. 

• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.  

Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
 
 

• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes. 

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers. 

• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths. 

• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.  

Operational Readiness & License to Operate
 
 

• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution. 

• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation. 

• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks. 

• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and operational release. 

Education & Experience
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline. 

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects. 

• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management. 

• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset. 

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.  

Knowledge & Affinity
 

You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
 
 

• European product legislation and conformity assessment; 

• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles; 

• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF); 

• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness; 

• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements; 

• Occupational safety and statutory inspections; 

• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.  

Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
 

Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
 

Competences
 
 

• Translate complexity into structure and action. 

• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders. 

• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities. 

• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills. 

• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery. 

• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.  

Languages
 
 

• Dutch: Fluent 

• English: Professional proficiency 

• French: Strong asset  

You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.
